Smart Doc Finder is built with Python · Redis (Streams + Vector DB + Semantic Cache) · MongoDB · React · Docker. Keyword search has one fatal flaw: you have to remember exactly how something was worded to find it. That's not how memory works, and it's not how understanding works either. Smart Doc Finder watches your document directory in real time via Redis Streams, chunks anything large into contextual blocks, embeds every chunk into Redis Vector Search, and checks a semantic cache before it even runs a query, so if someone asked something similar recently, it returns instantly. One Redis instance. Three jobs: event streaming, vector database, semantic cache. The architecture was the puzzle. Natural language search that actually works was the point.

[3] Project: FinSight
FinSight is built with Python · Mistral-7B · QLoRA (PEFT, bitsandbytes) · Transformers · vLLM · FastAPI · SEC EDGAR + XBRL. A Mistral-7B model trained to read an earnings press release and return its key figures as JSON. When a company reports a quarter, the four numbers a trading desk wants first (revenue, net income, diluted EPS and the period end) sit in a press release next to year-ago and year-to-date figures that look almost the same. FinSight fine-tunes Mistral-7B-Instruct with QLoRA to read an earnings release and return those four fields as JSON. The labels come free from the SEC. I pull each release (8-K Exhibit 99.1) from EDGAR, label it with the figures the company later filed in XBRL, and keep it only when those exact figures appear in the text the model reads. Train, validation and test are split by company, so the test set is made of companies the model never saw. Training runs in 4-bit on a free 16 GB T4. A first adapter is trained. The comparison against base Mistral, base Mistral with retrieved examples, and a large hosted model, on accuracy, cost per release and latency, is the next result, and its numbers go here once it has run. The repo also has vLLM serving behind a FastAPI endpoint, a CI eval gate, and a live watcher that answers new releases as they are filed and scores itself weeks later against the 10-Q.
